style.name: Nordic Folk Modern
style.definition: Simple pale timber furniture animated by woven pattern and handmade color.
style.materials: pine; woven wool; indigo cotton; red painted wood; glazed ceramic
style.living: cream pine-leg sofa; indigo woven pine armchair; red painted oval coffee table; pine media cabinet; compact pine table with four spindle chairs; pleated paper pendant; restrained red-blue folk-pattern rug
style.bed: pine spindle queen; ivory quilt and indigo-red woven throw; pine nightstands and blue ceramic lamps
style.solarium: teak outdoor seating with indigo performance cushions and red patterned pillows; simple teak dining set
style.implement: Put the strongest woven pattern on one rug and keep upholstery mostly solid.
style.avoid: Avoid costume-like themed objects or mixing unrelated motifs.
